title: Stick it out or rent elsewhere | Mumsnet

excerpts.text: This year we finally managed to sell our house after a lengthy process (for so many reasons!) we were so happy to finally have it done and to find our forever home. Until the seller pulled out. As it was supposed to be a short term thing we stayed with my pare

Oh just to add we stayed with them in the short term because there was going to be a gap of about five weeks between selling our home and the purchase of the new house going through. In case anyone asks why we didn’t go from our house to the new directly

They also don’t want us to move any furniture in the annexe even though some of it is wildly impractical with three young children and we wanted to do it to avoid anything getting broken. We are all tiptoeing around crystal paperweights

I would rent elsewhere. Rent a place for 6 months, this is no way to live. I’ll rather pay for the convenience and have my peace than live in that sort of condition just to save a few hundred pounds. The only issue is if it’ll be easy to get a rental. Have you
